title: A Bias Correction Approach for Interference in Ranking Experiments
authors: Ali Goli; Anja Lambrecht; Hema Yoganarasimhan
eligible_reason: Methods paper on interference in A/B tests of ranking algorithms at a travel agency. The DiD regressions compare algorithms across two test cohorts (felm(log(click_rate) ~ treat + period | AlgoName (+ day) | 0 | UserId)) and hotels before and after a cohort change in test proportions (felm(log(click.rate) ~ cohort_change + cohort_change:treated | HotelId)). One switch date per comparison, no unit-specific adoption. The main contribution is a neural-network bias-correction estimator of the total average treatment effect.
design_notes: R. ReplicationPackage/1.agg_patterns.R, 2.tables.R, 3.regs.R (DiD), 4.ML_model.R with ML_helpers (keras-style one/dual-layer binomial models).
data_provenance_note: ReadMe: datasets 'are synthetic and bear no direct relationship to the original data from the travel agency'.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Not a staggered DiD; synthetic data.
